name: fortigate-cloud
label: FortiGate Cloud
description: FortiGate Cloud is a cloud-based management platform for FortiGate devices. This connector facilitates automated operations to retrieve and add devices provisioned to FortiGate Cloud, manage their configuration backup and report schedules, and proxy FortiOS API calls to a managed FortiGate through FortiGate Cloud.

fields.name: region
fields.title: Region
fields.description: Select the FortiGate Cloud region that hosts your account. A device is only visible from the region it was provisioned into.
fields.tooltip: Select the FortiGate Cloud region that hosts your account. A device is only visible from the region it was provisioned into.

fields.name: server_url
fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Optionally specify the FortiGate Cloud API URL to override the selected region, for example https://api.fortigate.forticloud.com. Leave blank to use the region.
fields.tooltip: Optionally specify the FortiGate Cloud API URL to override the selected region, for example https://api.fortigate.forticloud.com. Leave blank to use the region.

fields.name: api_id
fields.title: API ID
fields.description: Specify the API ID, i.e. the username of the FortiCloud IAM API user, in UUID format XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX. The IAM API user must be granted Admin permissions for FortiGate Cloud.
fields.tooltip: Specify the API ID, i.e. the username of the FortiCloud IAM API user, in UUID format XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXX. The IAM API user must be granted Admin permissions for FortiGate Cloud.

fields.name: password
fields.title: Password
fields.description: Specify the password of the FortiCloud IAM API user.
fields.tooltip: Specify the password of the FortiCloud IAM API user.

fields.name: client_id
fields.title: Client ID
fields.description: Specify the client ID used to request the FortiGate Cloud access token.
fields.tooltip: Specify the client ID used to request the FortiGate Cloud access token.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified.
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified.

operations.title: Get Devices
operations.description: Retrieves the list of devices provisioned to FortiGate Cloud, optionally paginated and sorted.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.title: Limit
parameters.description: Specify the maximum number of devices to retrieve per page.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the maximum number of devices to retrieve per page.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.title: Offset
parameters.description: Specify the index of the first device to retrieve, starting from 0.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the index of the first device to retrieve, starting from 0.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.title: Sort
parameters.description: Specify the field by which to sort the results. Only 'sn' is supported.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the field by which to sort the results. Only 'sn' is supported.

operations.title: Get Device
operations.description: Retrieves the details of a specific device provisioned to FortiGate Cloud based on its serial number.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

operations.title: Add Device
operations.description: Adds a device to FortiGate Cloud using its device key.

parameters.name: device_key
parameters.title: Device Key
parameters.description: Specify the device key of the device to add to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the device key of the device to add to FortiGate Cloud.

operations.title: Update Device Management
operations.description: Enables or disables the FortiGate Cloud management feature for a device. Enabling management requires the FortiGate 'admin' user credentials; disabling it does not.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: management
parameters.title: Enable Management
parameters.description: Select this option to enable the management feature for the device, or clear it to disable management.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to enable the management feature for the device, or clear it to disable management.

parameters.name: username
parameters.title: Username
parameters.description: Specify the FortiGate 'admin' user name. Required when enabling management.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the FortiGate 'admin' user name. Required when enabling management.

parameters.name: password
parameters.title: Password
parameters.description: Specify the FortiGate 'admin' user password. Required when enabling management.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the FortiGate 'admin' user password. Required when enabling management.

parameters.name: force_password_change
parameters.title: Force Password Change
parameters.description: Select this option to force a password change on the device.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to force a password change on the device.

operations.title: Get Report Schedules
operations.description: Retrieves all report schedules configured for a device on FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

operations.title: Get Report Schedule
operations.description: Retrieves a specific report schedule configured for a device on FortiGate Cloud based on its OID.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: oid
parameters.title: Schedule OID
parameters.description: Specify the OID of the report schedule to retrieve.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the OID of the report schedule to retrieve.

operations.title: Add or Update Report Schedule
operations.description: Adds a report schedule for a device on FortiGate Cloud, or updates an existing schedule when its OID is specified.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: config_oid
parameters.title: Config OID
parameters.description: Specify the OID of the report configuration to schedule.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the OID of the report configuration to schedule.

parameters.name: oid
parameters.title: Schedule OID
parameters.description: Specify the OID of an existing report schedule to update. Leave blank to add a new schedule.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the OID of an existing report schedule to update. Leave blank to add a new schedule.

parameters.name: schedule_type
parameters.title: Schedule Type
parameters.description: Specify how often the report runs, for example: daily.
parameters.tooltip: Specify how often the report runs, for example: daily.

parameters.name: vdom
parameters.title: VDOM
parameters.description: Specify the VDOM for which to generate the report.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the VDOM for which to generate the report.

parameters.name: email
parameters.title: Email
parameters.description: Specify the email address to which to send the report.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the email address to which to send the report.

parameters.name: email_flag
parameters.title: Send Email
parameters.description: Select this option to email the report when it is generated.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to email the report when it is generated.

operations.title: Delete Report Schedule
operations.description: Deletes a report schedule from a device on FortiGate Cloud based on its OID.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: oid
parameters.title: Schedule OID
parameters.description: Specify the OID of the report schedule to delete.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the OID of the report schedule to delete.

operations.title: Get Config Auto Backup Setting
operations.description: Retrieves the configuration auto backup setting of a device on FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

operations.title: Update Config Auto Backup Setting
operations.description: Updates the configuration auto backup setting of a device on FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.title: Enable Auto Backup
parameters.description: Select this option to enable configuration auto backup for the device.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to enable configuration auto backup for the device.

parameters.name: backup_option
parameters.title: Backup Option
parameters.description: Specify when a backup is taken, for example: PERSESSION.
parameters.tooltip: Specify when a backup is taken, for example: PERSESSION.

parameters.name: alert

parameters.description: Select this option to send an alert when a configuration backup occurs.
parameters.tooltip: Select this option to send an alert when a configuration backup occurs.

parameters.name: alert_lang
parameters.title: Alert Language
parameters.description: Specify the language of the alert email, for example: en.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the language of the alert email, for example: en.

parameters.name: alert_emails

parameters.tooltip: Specify the email addresses to which to send backup alerts.

operations.title: Call FortiOS API
operations.description: Proxies a FortiOS API call to a managed FortiGate through FortiGate Cloud. The FortiGate must be deployed to FortiGate Cloud with configuration management enabled and its management tunnel online. Only the GET method is available on free FortiGate Cloud accounts; the POST, PUT and DELETE methods require a paid FortiGate.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.title: Serial Number
parameters.description: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the serial number of the FortiGate provisioned to FortiGate Cloud.

parameters.name: method
parameters.title: Method
parameters.description: Select the HTTP method of the FortiOS API call. POST, PUT and DELETE require a paid FortiGate.
parameters.tooltip: Select the HTTP method of the FortiOS API call. POST, PUT and DELETE require a paid FortiGate.

parameters.name: fos_api_path
parameters.title: FortiOS API Path
parameters.description: Specify the FortiOS API path to call, for example: api/v2/monitor/license/status. Refer to the FortiOS API documentation for available paths.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the FortiOS API path to call, for example: api/v2/monitor/license/status. Refer to the FortiOS API documentation for available paths.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.description: Specify the query parameters of the FortiOS API call as a JSON object. Refer to the FortiOS API documentation for available query parameters.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the query parameters of the FortiOS API call as a JSON object. Refer to the FortiOS API documentation for available query parameters.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.title: Payload
parameters.description: Specify the request body of the FortiOS API call as a JSON object. Applies to the POST and PUT methods.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the request body of the FortiOS API call as a JSON object. Applies to the POST and PUT methods.

operations.title: Generic API Call
operations.description: Makes an arbitrary call to the FortiGate Cloud API. Use this operation to reach endpoints that this connector does not expose as a dedicated action.

parameters.name: method
parameters.title: Method
parameters.description: Select the HTTP method of the API call.
parameters.tooltip: Select the HTTP method of the API call.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.description: Specify the API endpoint to call, relative to the FortiGate Cloud API base path, for example: /devices.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the API endpoint to call, relative to the FortiGate Cloud API base path, for example: /devices.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.title: Payload
parameters.description: Specify the request body of the API call as a JSON object.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the request body of the API call as a JSON object.
